test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A sum is divided into three parts in the ratio 2 : 3 : 5 . These parts are invested for 4 years at 5\% p.a., 6\% p.a., and 8\% p.a. simple interest respectively. If the total simple interest earned from all three investments after 4 years is 6,800 , find the total sum invested.
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Ratio of parts = 2 : 3 : 5 (Total parts = 10 units) Total Interest % = (2 × 5% × 4) + (3 × 6% × 4) + (5 × 8% × 4) = 40% + 72% + 160% = 272% of 1 unit 2.72 units = 6,800 1 unit = 6,800 ÷ 2.72 = 2,500 Total Sum (10 units) = 10 × 2,500 = 25,000 **∴ The correct answer is ₹25,000.**
